deep_dive.title: Better Nearest Neighbor Graph Indices via (Efficient) LLM-Guided Pruning
deep_dive.abstract: Graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) is widely used for large-scale semantic search. Its indices are constructed primarily based on geometric relationships among embeddings of an input dataset (e.g., documents or images), rather than explicitly optimizing for semantic relevance. However, when using these indices for downstream query retrieval, performance is evaluated based on the semantic relevance of the retrieved results to the query. This creates a fundamental "geometry-semantic" mismatch between how the indices are constructed and how their retrieval results are evaluated. While existing LLM-based reranking methods can partially mitigate this mismatch at query time, they leave this underlying structural problem in the graph unresolved. We therefore propose LLM-Guided Graph Pruning (LGP), a general framework that addresses this mismatch directly by leveraging LLM reasoning to refine an existing ANN graph index itself. LGP identifies structurally "low-value" neighbors of nodes and replaces them with LLM-selected alternatives that provide useful semantic information while retaining desired geometric structures of the original graph, including sparsity and efficient navigability. Experiments on representative semantic retrieval benchmarks show that LGP consistently improves end-to-end retrieval performance over both vanilla greedy graph search and LLM-based reranking across widely used graph-based ANN indices such as DiskANN and HNSW.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: This paper targets the geometry-semantic mismatch in graph-based approximate nearest neighbor search indices, proposing efficient LLM-guided pruning to improve graph index construction and retrieval quality for large-scale semantic search.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 基于图的近似最近邻搜索广泛用于大规模语义检索，但其索引主要依据嵌入的几何关系构建，未针对下游检索的语义相关性优化，造成几何与语义的错配，现有查询时重排只能部分缓解。论文提出利用大模型引导的高效剪枝来改进近邻图索引的构建，从而在结构层面纠正该错配。方法在提升检索语义相关性上取得效果，为图索引的构建提供了新思路。其贡献在于把语义信号引入近邻图索引构造，弥合了几何与语义之间的鸿沟。
